alternatives.decisionImpactIfSelected: Owner plus dependency/license/offline-CI decision required; package and lock changes require separately authorized scope
alternatives.reasonNotSelected: A CommonMark AST lint can improve prose hygiene but cannot strengthen the selected trust boundary because Markdown is non-authoritative; no parser is currently declared or locally resolvable

alternatives.decisionImpactIfSelected: prohibited ordinary Attempt 4 and continued open-ended case accumulation
alternatives.reasonNotSelected: regex, exact-string, marker, fence, case, indentation and path variants are an open presentation class and cannot prove unique authority

decision.selectionBasis: replace multiple presentation and pointer authorities with one closed structured candidate root; keep the final Git expectation outside the candidate to avoid a self-commit hash cycle; consume and cross-bind that reviewer-owned expectation

dependencyAssessment.operationsImpact: one dependency-free Node verifier plus one reviewer-owned external envelope; no install, cache, license or bundle impact

deliberateFalsePositives: unknown or extra machine roles, keys, paths or aliases reject even when a human believes them equivalent
an attached worktree on a different branch rejects even when its HEAD bytes equal the expected commit
non-canonical JSON bytes reject even when JSON.parse would produce the same value
notGuaranteed: semantic agreement between human prose and the structured root; Fresh independent human review remains required
future immobility of a mutable branch after the point-in-time verifier run
remote-host authenticity, actor authorization or cryptographic signing beyond the local Git/object and fixed-input trust boundary
Product/runtime correctness, Provider behavior or Phase B implementation behavior
positiveGuarantees: every executable/current role is enumerated exactly once by one duplicate-aware canonical structured root
no Markdown, heading, marker, fence, indentation, case or prose token can create or change machine authority
the consumed reviewer envelope's expected ref is equal to the sealed subject ref and resolves to the reviewer-pinned exact HEAD
HEAD, tree, single parent, cleanliness and attached/detached state are observed and cross-bound in one verifier run

algorithms: V1.12 exact stale/current string inventory as acceptance authority
V1.14 expectedView and designViewContract machine-view projection
all handwritten or regex CommonMark/fence/currentness parsers
bundle pointer validation that permits a second current path namespace
validateEnvelopePure when driven by synthetic local values rather than the consumed reviewer envelope
candidateCommittedArtifacts: CURRENT_AUTHORITY_SUBJECT_V1_0.json as a separate subject copy
CURRENT_AUTHORITY_IDENTITY_V1_0.json as a separate seal copy
CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ENVELOPE_V1_0.json as a candidate-committed nominal envelope
SEAL_SHA256SUMS.txt as a second package manifest
requiredRemovals.failedArtifactsDisposition: immutable evidence only; do not copy, merge, cherry-pick or make them authority

requiredRetentions: duplicate-aware JSON decoding before value consumption
RFC8785-compatible JCS and SHA-256 self/subject hashes
closed top-level and nested schemas with exact cardinalities
repo-relative POSIX NFC case-exact tracked regular-file paths
no absolute, dot, dot-dot, duplicate-slash, backslash, percent, control or out-of-root paths
symlink rejection and device/inode hard-link alias rejection across all role paths
no current/history role or path overlap
immutable failed-attempt and controlling-review identities as history only

chronology.result: V1.12 literal stale V3.0/V1.11 current authority remained

chronology.mechanism: exact case-sensitive strings plus one exact history marker pair and unbound generated pointer paths
chronology.result: V1.13 Markdown/case/marker/code-fence/path aliases passed; detached exact HEAD failed

chronology.mechanism: separate subject, identity seal, rendered machine view, pointer bundle, nominal envelope and CLI Git arguments
chronology.result: V1.14 valid CommonMark declarations bypassed the regex; sealed ref, CLI ref and ignored envelope were not cross-bound

rootCause.diagnosis: human presentation and multiple copied projections were treated as machine authority; every correction widened recognized cases without relocating authority to one closed structured root and one reviewer expectation boundary
sameRootWitnessFamilies: exact string, regex and presentation-sensitive Markdown scanning
fence length, indentation, marker and case variants

authorityArtifact.canonicalBytes: UTF-8 RFC8785-compatible JCS followed by one LF; safe-integer numeric domain; duplicate decoded member names rejected before parsing
authorityArtifact.pathContract: repo-relative POSIX NFC case-exact tracked regular file; no absolute/empty/dot/dot-dot/duplicate-slash/backslash/percent/control/out-of-root path; no symlink or physical hard-link alias
authorityArtifact.selfHash: seal.authorityJcsSha256 = SHA-256(JCS(root with only seal.authorityJcsSha256 omitted))

derivedEvidence.candidateManifest: one SHA256SUMS.txt generated last; it lists every candidate package file except itself and never acts as a second semantic authority
derivedEvidence.packageCapture: derived deterministic package output; not a current role and not hashed by the authority root
derivedEvidence.reviewCapture: generated only after final Candidate commit and stored by the independent reviewer, never fed back into the Candidate seal

gitIdentityClosure.attached: symbolic HEAD is permitted only when its exact full ref equals externalEnvelope.expectedGit.ref; otherwise reject
gitIdentityClosure.detached: empty symbolic HEAD is valid when exact HEAD/ref/tree/parent checks pass
gitIdentityClosure.expectedRefBinding: externalEnvelope.expectedGit.ref must equal root.subject.candidateRef before resolving either
gitIdentityClosure.head: externalEnvelope.expectedGit.head must equal ref target and observed HEAD
gitIdentityClosure.parent: exactly one parent; external expected parent, expected HEAD^ and observed HEAD^ must agree
gitIdentityClosure.tree: external expected tree, expected HEAD^{tree} and observed HEAD^{tree} must agree

markdown.policy: rendered human documentation only; verifier may hash its bytes as renderedDesign but must not parse headings, markers, code fences, info strings, JSON blocks, paths or prose to enumerate authority
markdown.reservedDeclarationLint: deleted with the reserved declaration concept; no blocking CommonMark lint remains

reviewEnvelope.consumption: future verifier accepts --authority and --review-envelope only; it duplicate-aware parses and JCS-hashes the external envelope, binds it to the root, and uses every expectedGit field
reviewEnvelope.location: reviewer-owned disposable path or independent-review evidence, outside the Candidate commit

terminalCondition: callback to coordinator and stop; no Corrected Design or implementation begins in this task
